1.why: All 14 screenshots show a static, white-card layout with no animations, carousels, or pop-up dialogs; only a collapsible help section and a text log area.

2.why: Bold headings, a highlighted active step chip in the progress bar, a single dark-blue primary button per card, and green confirmation text make key elements stand out, though the persistent 'Logs' panel competes for attention.

3.why: Each page presents one task with one field and one button plus fixed top navigation (Password recovery / Secure sign-in / Privacy conditions), so the next action is easy to locate; only the developer-style Logs block adds noise.

4.why: The numbered progress bar and 'Next: ...' banner carry the state for her, but she still must carry codes from the Logs panel into fields and recall the 12-character password rule.

5.why: No password manager hint, autofill affordance, 'remember me' checkbox, show-password toggle, or trusted-device option appears on any screen, including the sign-in page.

6.why: Nothing personal or previously saved is displayed — no masked email, no saved username or account name; the only 'familiar' items are raw simulated tokens in the Logs list.

7.why: Text is in short one- or two-sentence chunks with plain wording such as 'Start by requesting a recovery code. You can pause and return safely.'

8.why: No error state is shown in any of the 14 screenshots, so the claim that error messages describe problem and fix cannot be observed as true of this system.

9.why: The password rule is stated ('12 or more characters with uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a symbol') but no sample password, code format, or worked example is provided for any field.

10.why: The password + emailed code path is clearly labelled, but there is no choice of authentication method (no face, biometric, or alternate option), so 'choices are clear' holds only trivially.

11.why: Every screen offers essentially one decision — a single input and its button — with at most a secondary 'Forgot your password?' link or 'Sign out'.

12.why: Green confirmations such as 'Password confirmed. Next, confirm your security code.', 'Privacy conditions accepted...', plus the step banner and appended Logs entries state each outcome.

13.why: A 'Help and safe sign-in reminders' panel with tips appears on every page and each step has a short 'Next: ...' instruction banner, though the tips are generic rather than step-specific.

14.why: Fields and buttons remain available for re-entry, codes can be re-sent via 'Send security code', and a 'Forgot your password? Start recovery' link allows restarting; no retry-limit or error/recovery screen is shown to confirm forgiveness explicitly.

15.why: Header, navigation, card structure, typography, button styling, help panel, and Logs panel are identical across all 14 steps.
